title: 第5章 我是五行灵根第6章 灵宝

第5章我是五行灵根？
“这里是哪里？”
林浩惊疑不定的打量四周。
“小家伙，咱们终于可以见面了。”
突然一个苍老沙哑的声音，从小塔中传来。
“你是谁？我为什么会出现在这里。”
林浩有些胆怯的问道。
毕竟，作为地球人，看过不少老怪物夺舍的小说。
他明明修炼得好好的，莫名进入特殊的空间，让他有些慌。
“小家伙，不必惊慌，我不会害你，这里是你的识海空间。”
苍老沙哑的声音不急不缓的道：“我乃长生仙尊的残魂，你前方的小塔，叫万古长生塔，是本尊的灵宝，你可愿意拜我为师？”
“你为什么收我为徒？”
林浩警惕的道。
天下没有免费的午餐，这长生仙尊一听名字，便感觉来历极大，来收他这种小人物为徒，肯定对他有什么图谋。
“因为你是本尊苦苦寻找多年，才好不容易找到的拥有五行灵根的人。”
长生仙尊残魂笑着道。
“我是五行灵根？这怎么可能！
五行灵根是修仙界有名的废灵根，根本无法修炼。”
半月来林浩对修仙一些基本知识有了些了解，他皱眉道：“而我加入玄岳宗时间才半月，就修炼到了炼气一重，这修炼速度堪比拥有六品单属性灵根的天才……怎会是五行灵根。”
“有什么不可能的。”

长生仙尊残魂沉吟片刻道：“你确实是五行灵根，之所以修炼这么快，是因为本尊用灵宝万古长生塔，给你输送灵气。”
“没本尊的万古长生塔输送灵气给你，你这五行灵根，想要达到炼气一重，至少需要几年。”
长生仙尊残魂继续道。
“如果我真是废灵根之称的五行灵根，那掌门关门弟子柳师姐，为何要亲自把我招收进宗门。”
林浩不死心的道。
“嘿嘿，自然是本尊略施手段，伪造出六品火属性单灵根，引起了那小丫头的注意，她才把你带到了这里来。”
长生仙尊残魂解释道：“你之前所在的山贼窝，灵气太稀薄了，只有在修仙宗门这种灵气浓郁的地方，本尊的法宝万古长生塔，才能发挥出作用。”
“若是还不信，你找块测试灵根的石头，自己测试一下灵根便知道本尊没有撒谎。”
他继续道。
见长生仙尊言之凿凿，林浩不由信了几分。
“既然我是五行废灵根，你为什么要收我为徒。”
林浩沉默片刻问道。
“谁说五行灵根是废灵根了，实际上在远古时期的修仙界，五行灵根乃天地间最顶级的灵根，战力碾压同境界，号称同境界无敌。”
长生仙尊残魂苍老沙哑的声音响起，道：“想当年，本尊只是被测试出不入品的五行灵根，就轰动了整个远古修仙界，被各大顶级修仙圣地，抢得头破血流……。”
“你说的五行灵根这么厉害，可为什么现在的五行灵根？在修仙界是人人都嫌的废灵根啊！”
林浩脸上露出疑惑之色。
“因为，天地间曾经发生过一场大劫，导致天地灵气比远古年间，少了太多。”
“让需要更多灵气修行的多属性灵种，不再占优势。”
长生仙尊残魂继续道：“反而在远古时期，废物一样的单灵根，因为修炼所需灵气少，速度快的优势，成了目前修仙界的宠儿。”
“原来如此！”

林浩明白了过来，不禁有些担忧道：“我的五行灵根就算是远古时期最好的灵根，但到了现在天地灵气大量变少，后面能修炼到筑基吗？”

Chapter 5 Am I the Five Elements Spiritual Root?
"Where is this?"
Lin Hao looked around in confusion.
"Little one, we can finally meet."
Suddenly an old and hoarse voice came from the small tower.
"Who are you? Why do I appear here."
Lin Hao asked timidly.
After all, as an earthling, I have read many novels about old monsters seizing bodies.
He was obviously practicing well, but entering a special space inexplicably made him panic.
"Little guy, don't panic, I won't harm you, this is your consciousness sea space."
The old and hoarse voice said unhurriedly: "I am the remnant soul of the Immortal Lord of Immortality. The small tower in front of you is called the Eternal Eternal Life Tower. It is my spiritual treasure. Are you willing to worship me as your master?"
"Why did you accept me as your disciple?"
Lin Hao said vigilantly.
There is no free lunch in the world. As soon as this Immortal Master heard his name, he felt that he had a great origin. To accept a small person like him as his disciple, he must have some plot against him.
"Because you are the person with the Five Elements Spiritual Roots that I have been searching for for many years and finally found."
The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord of Immortality said with a smile.
"I am the Five Elements Spiritual Root? How is this possible!
The Five Elements Spiritual Root is a famous useless spiritual root in the world of immortality, and cannot be cultivated at all. "
In the past half month, Lin Hao had gained some basic knowledge about cultivating immortals. He frowned and said, "It has only been half a month since I joined the Xuanyue Sect, and I have already reached the first level of Qi refining. This speed of cultivation is comparable to that of a genius with a sixth-grade single-attribute spiritual root... How can it be the five-element spiritual root."
"What's impossible?"
The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord of Immortality pondered for a moment and said: "You are indeed the Five Elements Spiritual Root. The reason why you cultivate so quickly is because I use the Spiritual Treasure Eternal Immortality Tower to convey spiritual energy to you."
"The Eternal Eternal Life Tower without me will send you spiritual energy. If you want to reach the first level of Qi refining with your Five Elements spiritual roots, it will take at least several years."
The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord Eternal Life continued.
"If I really have the Five Elements Spiritual Root, which is known as the Waste Spiritual Root, then why did Senior Sister Liu, the disciple who is the leader of the sect, recruit me into the sect personally?"
Lin Hao said unwillingly.
"Hehe, naturally I used some tricks to forge a sixth-grade fire attribute single spiritual root, which attracted the attention of the little girl, and she brought you here."
The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord of Immortality explained: "The bandits' den where you were before has too thin spiritual energy. Only in a place with strong spiritual energy like the Immortal Cultivation Sect, can my magic weapon Eternal Immortality Tower be effective."
"If you still don't believe me, find a stone to test your spiritual roots. Test your spiritual roots yourself and you will know that I am not lying."
he continued.
Lin Hao couldn't help but believe the words of Immortal Immortal Changsheng.
"Since I have five elements of useless spiritual roots, why do you want to accept me as your disciple?"
Lin Hao asked after a moment of silence.
"Who said that the Five Elements Spiritual Roots are useless spiritual roots? In fact, in the world of immortal cultivation in ancient times, the Five Elements Spiritual Roots were the top spiritual roots in the world. Their combat power crushed those in the same realm, and they were said to be invincible in the same realm."
The old and hoarse voice of the remnant soul of the Immortal Lord Immortal rang out, "I think back then, when my five-element spiritual roots were found to be of inferior quality, I caused a sensation in the entire ancient world of immortality. I was beaten to death by all the top holy places for cultivating immortals..."
"The Five Elements Spiritual Roots you mentioned are so powerful, but why are the Five Elements Spiritual Roots now? In the world of immortal cultivation, everyone despises the useless Spiritual Roots!"
Lin Hao had a look of confusion on his face.
"Because a great catastrophe once occurred between heaven and earth, resulting in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth being much less than in ancient times."
"Let the multi-attribute spiritual species that require more spiritual energy practice no longer have the upper hand."
The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord Eternal Life continued: "On the contrary, in ancient times, single spiritual roots, which were like waste, became the favorite of the current world of immortality because of the advantages of less spiritual energy required for cultivation and fast speed."
"That's it!"
Lin Hao understood and couldn't help but said worriedly: "My Five Elements Spiritual Root is the best spiritual root in ancient times, butNow that the spiritual energy of heaven and earth has decreased a lot, will it be possible to practice foundation building in the future? "
